# Hornero Signal design system — evidence

Captured with Playwright (Chromium) against the local Astro dev server of
this branch (`after-*`) and against production (`www.horneroos.com`) before the
change (`before-*`). Browser screenshots of the website, not desktop
captures.

- `before-home-1280.png` — production homepage, Hornero 199X.
- `after-home-night-1280.png` — homepage chrome in Signal Night (homepage
  body is reworked in the follow-up homepage PR).
- `after-install-day-1280.png` — Signal Day on the install page.
- `after-editions-night-360.png` — top rail and segmented switches at 360 px.
